description: Index of the Kokoro-82M Core ML size tiers. Each folder is self-contained and has its own manifest.json (packages, compiled sizes, interfaces, compute units, metrics, hashes). Only tiers that passed speed and sound are included; the S018 student in 25mb and 50mb replaced the S017 student, and its speed and listening results are marked pending in the tier manifests until the phone result files are staged.

checkpoints.description: Trained PyTorch checkpoints behind the student packages, so conversion can be re-run without retraining (s014_convert_student.py, s015_convert.py). Not needed to run the tiers.

files.role: S014 width-256 student: model weights, config, step, eval. No optimizer state. The starting point of the S018 student (kokoro_student_w256 in 25mb/ and 50mb/); see docs/README_RETRAIN.md in the GitHub repository.

S015 pruned student vocoder (training run v4-prune) at step 10000, the source of kokoro_s015_vocoder_int8: vocoder weights and config, plus the unused S015 pitch student (the shipped pitch model is the Kokoro int8 package). No optimizer or discriminator state.

500mb.label: Baseline (at most 500 MB)
500mb.shape_note: This tier is built from fixed-shape multifunction packages. It supports ONLY the five frozen benchmark shapes (token functions t56, t110, t237, t260, t280 and frame functions f146, f275, f567, f614, f633). Arbitrary text lengths are not supported. Flexible token and frame lengths start at the 50mb tier (S014).
500mb.recipe: Kokoro-82M v1.0 split into five stages, fp32, with the five shapes of each stage sharing one weight file (coremltools save_multifunction).
500mb.size_measurement: compiled_logical_bytes = sum of file sizes (os.stat st_size) of the .mlmodelc that `xcrun coremlcompiler compile` produces from the package, the same bytes Xcode puts in the app. package_sha256 = sha256 over every file sorted by relative path: relative path bytes then file bytes. coremldata.bin inside a compile can differ by a few bytes between runs.
